<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );

$home  = untrailingslashit( home_url() );
$post  = substr( get_permalink( 1 ), strlen( $home ) );
$rules = <<<RULES
# Every line below is a live redirect on this site. Try two of them:
#   {$home}/about-us
#   {$home}/blog{$post}
# Edit the list, then press Save Changes (or Cmd/Ctrl + S).

# Plain paths. Rules use 301 (Moved Permanently) until a status line changes it.
/about-us: /sample-page/
/team: /sample-page/#team

# A number on the right is a post or page ID, so the link survives a slug change.
/welcome: 1

# External targets.
/docs: https://wordpress.org/plugins/redirect-txt/

# Regular expressions start with ^. \$1, \$2... insert the captured groups.
# The blog moved from /blog/ to the site root:
^/blog/(.*): /\$1/

# Status lines. Every rule after "302:" uses 302 (Found), a temporary redirect.
302:
/summer-sale: /sample-page/

# 410 tells visitors and search engines the page is gone for good.
410:
/discontinued-product: /discontinued-product
RULES;

$request = new WP_REST_Request( 'POST', '/redirect-txt/v1/update_rules' );
$request->set_param( 'rules', $rules );
$response = rest_do_request( $request );
if ( $response->is_error() || empty( $response->get_data()['success'] ) ) {
	throw new Exception( 'Redirect.txt rules were not saved: ' . wp_json_encode( $response->get_data() ) );
}

$request = new WP_REST_Request( 'POST', '/redirect-txt/v1/update_settings' );
$request->set_param( 'settings', array( 'redirect_logs' => 7, '404_logs' => 7 ) );
rest_do_request( $request );
